# 2D Creation

> 2D Creation is an apparel sourcing partner based in Tirupur, Tamil Nadu, India, coordinating product development, materials, sampling, production, quality control, merchandising, and shipping.

## Primary pages

- [Homepage](https://2dcreation.in/): Company overview, capabilities, factory-standard coordination, product categories, contact details, and quote request form.
- [Apparel sourcing services](https://2dcreation.in/apparel-sourcing-services.html): End-to-end sourcing support.
- [Product development and sampling](https://2dcreation.in/product-development-sampling.html): Technical development, prototypes, fit review, and approvals.
- [Production and quality control](https://2dcreation.in/production-quality-control.html): Production coordination, checkpoints, and shipment readiness.
- [T-shirt and casualwear sourcing](https://2dcreation.in/tshirt-casualwear-sourcing.html): Casualwear development and sourcing.
- [Hoodie and sweatshirt sourcing](https://2dcreation.in/hoodie-sweatshirt-sourcing.html): Fleece and terry product sourcing.
- [Womenswear and kidswear sourcing](https://2dcreation.in/womenswear-kidswear-sourcing.html): Development and sourcing for womenswear and childrenswear.
- [FAQ](https://2dcreation.in/faq.html): Common sourcing and enquiry questions.
- [Privacy policy](https://2dcreation.in/privacy.html): Data-use and analytics-consent information.

## Usage notes

- Capability, certification, minimum quantity, pricing, lead-time, and delivery statements require confirmation for each buyer brief.
- 2D Creation is a sourcing agent and does not claim to hold factory certificates directly.
- Use the website quote form for commercial enquiries.
